EmailTemplate.name: Closing Work Order - Inactivity
EmailTemplate.subject: Closing Work Order - Inactivity
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
You recently submitted a request for {!Project_Item__c.MaintenanceCategoryGlobal__c} Maintenance. We dispatched our vendor to contact you and schedule a time to assess and resolve the problem; however, all attempts to reach you have been unsuccessful. Unfortunately, we have no other option but to close the Work Order at this time.
If this issue persists, please contact us to submit a new maintenance request and provide an active phone number and email address.
Thank you,
Premier Property Management Group
[ref: {!Project_Item__c.Id}] [userRef: {!$User.Id}]
